differences.what: T-2855: the camera is re-solved (tools/glessner_north_pairs.py) with the gable pairs' sill and head left free. T-2200's frozen camera had taken the heads at the corridor rows' 22.25 ft and so drew the windows about two feet high. On the re-solved camera the corner, the grade line, both upper pairs (rebuilt at 19.6-24.3 ft, the photographs' reading) and the two narrow first-floor lights fall where the photograph has them.

T-2868: each pair's lights and colonnette. The photograph shows the capital about 27 px (1.3 ft) wide over a round shaft about 1.0 ft across; the model's 1.9-ft plan pier had drawn the shaft about 1.4 ft and read as a broad pale panel. The inner jambs, read through this camera and HABS 14's (tools/glessner_north_pairs.py, north-pairs.json#jambs), are rebuilt at the 1.3-ft pier (W 10.55/11.85 and 28.45/29.8), the capital at its read 1.1 ft and the base at 0.5 ft: in the render the east pair's pier stands at x 897.5-923.5 against the print's 897.5-925.5, and the west pair's shaft ends at x 1306 against the capital's 1303 beside the pole. The sash frames are drawn dark where the print shows them painted white; paint is not geometry and the 1965 colour does not establish 1904's.

North masonry/course texture and pair detailing differ. T-3044: on Taylor 2135 the 18th Street face's courses fit within about 1-2 % of the Prairie corner's, so one coursing still turns the corner. Their height is T-3045's, and their relief T-3046's. T-3045 laid the heights (the fixed entry below), and T-3046 the relief on both granite faces, one coursing round the corner, closing with Taylor 2135's: a course printed 11.5 in or over now crowns 1.25 times its stones' bow and rises to it over at most 0.09 m, so through Taylor 2135's camera, on the laid beds, a high course's lower-lip shadow reads 1.33 times a low course's in the render against 1.32 in the photograph (0.86 before; docs/RESEARCH/glessner-course-relief-T-3046/).
Signs, poles, cars, neighbor fabric and ground alterations date to1965; the photograph does not establish1904 RGB.

T-2848 light: the photograph was taken under an overcast sky (wet street, no shadow from the poles beside the wall); the render now uses the overcast sky (camera solve.light), so the shaded north facade is no longer raked by the review sun.
T-2848: the stone in this print is darkened by decades of city soot, so its tone in the 1960s photograph is not its 1887 tone; the render's clean stone is not compared against it.

T-3045 course heights: the 18th Street courses rise with the Prairie front's (one coursing round the NE corner), the corridor lights stand on beds 8-15 and 19-23 at their new heights, and this camera was re-solved on the narrow light at 9.3044-14.7471 ft (tools/glessner_north_pairs.py --cameras), which reads the gable pairs at 19.89-24.43 ft; the record builds 19.83-24.52 from both north plates. Reviewed on the re-rendered side-by-side: the pairs and the narrow lights sit on the photograph's.
T-3115: the crosses are draped on the stack's rock (they stood 2-4 cm proud of it); at this camera's scale they read as before.

T-3136, read on this side-by-side at 2x (GLB 6ba8c9f7): the two gable pairs' lights do not read as built. The east wing's pair (W 7.2-14.7, built 3.35 and 2.85 ft) shows two equal lights, 65 px each either side of a 27.5 px colonnette (about 3.1 ft each at the pair's 21 px a foot), where the render draws 72.5 and 59 px. The tower shoulder's pair (W 25.8-32.9, built 2.65 and 3.1 ft) shows 65 and 67.5 px (about 2.9-3.0 ft each) where the render draws 52.5 and 60, and the print's eastern jamb stands 27 px and its western 15 px east of the render's. T-3045 re-solved this camera on heights, so camera and plan are not separated here; T-3142 reads the pairs with HABS 14 and rules them. T-3140, ruled within tolerance (T-3153): both pairs are there, two lights each round a colonnette, as built. The lights differ from the build's by 0.25-0.5 ft, under the 1 ft bar; the jambs' 15-27 px (about 0.7-1.3 ft) rest on a camera re-solved on heights that this print alone cannot part from the plan, which puts the outer jambs within 0.1-0.3 ft. T-3142 was withdrawn on this ground.

_how: verdict is unreviewed | differs | matches, set by whoever compared the side-by-side with the picture; each difference is {what, status: open | fixed | not shown | within tolerance} — open only if a street visitor would notice it (over about 1 ft, missing, mis-shaped, miscounted, wrong material or colour), else within tolerance (T-3153). A ticket whose ## Image gate names this building does not close while it is not "matches" (tools/image_gate.mjs).
